description: This file defines Data Transfer Objects (DTOs) for product-related API endpoints in a Java backend project, including response and request DTOs with validation annotations.

classes.name: ProductDtos
classes.description: A container class for various product DTO records used in API communication.

methods.name: ProductResponse
methods.description: A record for sending product data in responses.

methods.name: CreateProductRequest
methods.description: A record for creating a new product, with validation annotations.

methods.name: UpdateProductRequest
methods.description: A record for updating product information, with optional fields and validation annotations.
